OPERATIVE / PROCEDURE NOTE - CARDIAC CATHETERISATION LABORATORY St. Aldric Regional Medical Center Cath Lab Lab 2 Date: 13 September 2081 Start 07:31 End 08:24 Patient: Yilder, Matthew 5520-1194 Age 54 Sex M Operator: Joon-ho Baek, MD Assistant: Dr. Teixeira (fellow) Scrub: Patience Wells Pre-op diagnosis: Acute anterior ST segment elevation myocardial infarction. Post-op diagnosis: same, culprit lesion proximal LAD thrombotic occlusion. Procedure: emergent left heart catheterisation, coronary angiography, primary PCI of the LAD with drug eluting stent. Access: right radial artery, 6 French. Anaesthesia: local lidocaine 1%, no sedation because patient anxious but cooperating, wife outside. Consent: Obtained from the patient with phone interpreter Zeynep (Turkish). Name on wristband first was YILDIRIM, MEHMET - old registration, we have verified with date of birth 02/17/2027 and corrected the band.
FINDINGS: Left main normal. LAD: proximal total thrombotic occlusion, TIMI 0. Circumflex: 40 percent mid. RCA dominant, mild plaque. EF by ventriculogram about 45 percent. DESCRIPTION: Heparin was given in ED plus additional bolus, ACT at target. Aspiration thrombectomy, then 3.0 x 24 mm drug eluting stent deployed in proximal LAD, post-dilated, TIMI 3 flow restored, no residual stenosis, no dissection. Door to balloon time 39 minutes. Patient had no complication, chest pain free at end. Stent device: serial DES-30024-77Q, lot L 8830921. Implant card issued name Mehmet Yildirim - card to be reprinted. Blood loss minimal. Contrast 140 mL. Fluoro time 9.2 min. Plan: CCU, prasugrel 10 plus aspirin 81 (clopidogrel only loading dose from ED), atorvastatin, nebivolol, TR band removal 4 hours. Echo.
Dictated by Joon-ho Baek MD. Transcribed 09/13/2081 11:10 by jhbaek_dict. Surgeon wish to add: stent is not a "Plavix" stent, please do not write like that.
